notes.title: Lu[Idle] 0.61
notes.content:
Lu[Idle] 0.61

- You now may release any game you would like as long as you have released the previous one before. 

- You now may not keep grinding for Pre-Orders after completing the current game.

- When closing and reopening the game your pre-orders should be the right value instead of doubling.

notes.title: Lu[Idle] 0.6 BIGGEST UPDATE YET
notes.content:
Lu[Idle] 0.6 has been a long time in the making and its finally here! 
You can find the full patch notes in the discord server but here is a quick overview of what has been changed/added:
- The console now has 3 new options at the bottom for switching between the main things that the console did before.
- THERE ARE 2 NEW PRESTIGES! they both give extra rewards upon completing them equal to the difficulty of completing them.
- There is now many new options that have been moved from the console to the settings menu.
- The Lua guide book has been removed as I have made the typing part of the console for secret commands only and moved the things it did before into separate options that are easier to navigate to.

JOIN THE DISCORD FOR THE FULL PATCH NOTES - 
https://discord.gg/vnWGuSBCkv

Check out the announcement trailer for Lu[Idle] 0.6 that shows off some of the new content!

notes.title: Lu[Idle] Speed Run Competition For Money
notes.content:
The top player in each of the 3 set speed running categories will earn $10
                                                                                 (Paid out Via Venmo or Apple Pay)
The Competition Ends September 14th at 11:59pm

The 3 categories are -
Coffee% - Fastest time to get the coffee upgrade starting from nothing.
Megabyte% - Fastest time to get a megabyte starting from nothing. (must have it. can't be lifetime score)
Game Release% - Fastest time to hit the release button to earn sales starting from nothing.

The rules are as follows:
1. No Auto clickers
2. Must provide a video with a timer on screen
3. No cheating runs (Decided at Sneakpanda's discretion)
4. Run starts as soon as you hit enter after typing "delete save" into the console
5. You may only submit one run for each category totaling 3 runs.

Tip - LiveSplit is a free and easy to use speed run timer

Instructions for Submitting a Run:
1. Join the Lu[Idle] Discord Here: https://discord.gg/vnWGuSBCkv
2. Navigate to the Speed Running Category and go to the forum channel that suits what category you are 
    submitting for. Thats either coffee-percent, megabyte-percent, or game-release-percent.
3. Please only submit one run for each category, as your first run in each category will be the only ones 
    counted.

WINNINGS - 
 The Fastest time in each category by September 14th will earn $10 (Paid out via Venmo or Apple Pay)

How to Save Your Pre-Existing Lu[Idle] Progress - 
1. Do Windows + R and type %appdata%
2. Find the folder that is titled "Lu[idle]game" and double click it
3. Rename the file called "savedata" to anything other than save data
4. Boom you just created a save file, when you open the game again, a new "savedata" file will be made 
    and the file you renamed will still be in the "Lu[idle]game" folder
5. when you want to get back to your main progress, rename your original savedata file back to 
    "savedata" and either delete the new "savedata" file or rename it to anything but "savedata".

notes.title: Hotfix 0.54
notes.content: Fixed an issue that occurs after your first prestige which breaks the pixel by pixel image.

notes.title: Hot Fix / Small Content Update
notes.content:
Content Update

- Added a "weak spot" to the Code Bar which adds a +0.1 Multiplier per weak spot clicked to the bytes 
      gained from clicking weak spots. The combo resets along with the multiplier if you fail to click a weak 
      spot within 3 seconds of clicking the previous weak spot.

Hot Fix

- Fixed an issue where your Pre-orders would be doubled whenever you launched the game.



Make sure to leave the game a good review if you like it :)

notes.title: Small update/fix
notes.content:
In this tiny update/fix I changed an array having to do with the number that shows up when you click the code bar which now actually deletes the number after it fades away hopefully fixing performance issues.
I also added art to the prestige upgrades.
